name: Duzay
description: Duzay was a world in the galaxy. In 1 ABY, a group of tourists from Duzay sojourned at the Lake Retreat Hotel during their stay on Naboo. An employee of the hotel named Rovim Minnoni recruited a spacer to rescue these tourists when they got lost during a walk in the wilderness.
lead_paragraphs: Duzay was a world in the galaxy. In 1 ABY, a group of tourists from Duzay sojourned at the Lake Retreat Hotel during their stay on Naboo. An employee of the hotel named Rovim Minnoni recruited a spacer to rescue these tourists when they got lost during a walk in the wilderness.
